subject: general
question: P. Q and R alone can complete a piece of work in 30 hours, 10 hours and 15 hours respectively. In how much time they will finish the work, if they worked together?
solution:
Given:

P. Q and R alone can complete a piece of work in 30 hours, 10 hours, and 15 hours respectively

Concept used:

Efficiency = (Total work / Total time taken)

Efficiency = work done in a single day 

Calculation:

Let total work is 60 units ( Lcm of 30, 10, and 15)

The efficiency of P is 60 / 30 = 2 units

The efficiency of Q is 60 / 10 = 6 units

The efficiency of R is 60 / 15 = 4 units

Total efficiency of P. Q and R is 2 + 6 + 4 = 12 units 

Total time taken by them together is

⇒ 60 / 12 hours = 5 hours

**∴ The correct option is 1**
